name: ama me (in incisis)
source:
After much wait, your old friend from high school finally replies to your letter and agrees to meet you for coffee at the local bar. Reconnect with him and be besties again—or don't!

[From [url=https://radicalhoodie.itch.io/ama-me-in-incisis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过漫长的等待，你高中的老朋友终于回复了你的信，并同意在当地的酒吧与你见面喝咖啡。与他重新建立联系，再次成为好朋友——或者不做！

[来自[url=https://radicalhoodie.itch.io/ama-me-in-incisis]itch.io[/url]]
